title: Repair dead links in the root README research index
prompt: Seven relative links near the end of `README.md` point at files that are not in the repository root (`./RESEARCH.md`, `./RESEARCH_P256.md`, `./RESEARCH_RESIDUAL_WALKS.md`, `./RESEARCH_TII_MCELIECE.md`, `./RESEARCH_EXOTIC_COORDINATES.md`, `./DEFERRED.md`, `./docs/RESEARCH_BENCH_LOG.md`). Find where each document went, using git history, and repair each link. If a document is gone for good, say so and keep the entry as plain text with a note instead of a link. Leave every other link in README.md alone.
setup: Restore the pre-fix files: `git checkout 0b9d7b861ed51b73c83187b5c03e17de73ea117a -- README.md` (that commit holds the broken starting state).  Not a harness-written fixture.
acceptance: none of the seven targets remains a dead relative link
README.md still lists all seven entries (as a link or as annotated plain text)
check_command: python3 -c "import re,os;f='README.md';t=open(f).read();bad=[x for x in re.findall(r'\]\((\./[^)#\s]+)',t) if re.search(r'RESEARCH|DEFERRED',x) and not os.path.exists(x)];print(bad);raise SystemExit(1 if bad else 0)" && for n in RESEARCH_P256 RESEARCH_RESIDUAL_WALKS RESEARCH_TII_MCELIECE RESEARCH_EXOTIC_COORDINATES DEFERRED RESEARCH_BENCH_LOG; do grep -q "$n" README.md || exit 1; done && [ "$(git diff --name-only "$T_BASE" HEAD | grep -vc '^README.md$')" = 0 ]
forbidden: editing a file whose SHA-256 a tracked manifest pins (frozen evidence) to make a check pass
disabling, skipping, deleting or weakening a test or check to make it pass
editing the checking tool or its allow-list so that it passes
deleting entries to make the check pass
pointing links at files that do not exist
notes: Dead links found by scanning relative link targets, 2026-11-15. ./RESEARCH.md matches the 'RESEARCH' filter; the check leaves false positives elsewhere in README.md (sessions/..., tables/) alone.
